DPS is calculated as (Ammo x Damage) ÷ (Ammo x Firerate + (Ammo ÷ Burst Size - 1) x Burst Cooldown + Reload Time).
Includes both the DPS from the guns and the missiles

Number is the damage dealt in the inner explosion sphere. Splash damage is decreased linearly from the edge of the inner explosion sphere to the edge of the outer explosion sphere, if the enemy is in the outer explosion sphere.
DPS is calculated as Splash Damage ÷ Ability Cooldown.
Total DPS is calculated as Pistol DPS + Rocket DPS.
Rocket DPS assumes only one enemy is hit with all rockets and it receives full splash damage.
